name: Founder decision: Set every parameter of the architecture on the register, with Dominic's domain and counsel, and none in this program
text_content:
P26, P31, P34, P35. The percentage; the base's revenue classes and the comp-at-menu-price rule; the seat weight at each horizon per seat, with kitchen seats chef-gated; the marker values for cross-strand, cross-period, and teaching; the salaried seats' salaries and their every-open-day rule or the outside-the-pool alternative; the edge seats' hourly wages; the payment rhythm, bounded by pay-date law and the platform; the authorship and translation payments per approved version; the generosity range's value and the financial recovery threshold, set by Dominic's domain against the financial model and written on the holder's range card; the benefits gate's conditions; and the closed-day pay rule. Each row is set by versioned decision on the partners' page with its owner and what it is set against, or marked unset, and the transparency sheet's item 6 reads from it or reads "being finalized." Financials are not a context source for this program and no value appears on the page; the team's constraints on the rows (the comp rule, no training weight below entry, one rule for everyone in a seat) are recommended beside them. The rows an offer needs (the percentage, the base, the two lead seats' weights and salaries, the rhythm) sit ahead of the leads' offers on the hiring calendar. Extends 86akh9tb0, 86akh9tbw, and 86akh9tbz by reference. Before the leads' offers. Urgent.

Filed by Session 13 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmjey. Reasoning lives on the S13 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
